title: miscellaneous_craft
description: A simple datapack witch add/modify crafting recipes ! 😉
body:
# Explainations and content of this datapack:

This datapack **only add recipes** and have no plan to use any kind of function.

For the stone of the piston you can use: cobblestone, cobbled_deepslate, blackstone or even end_stone.
For the wool to string craft: any kind of wool work.

By the way every single recipes also work with the crafter.

If you have more ideas other craft let me know !

PS:
I'm not a native English speaker, feel free to focus on the datapack itself.
